why: The whole point of issue #260's store is that the pane's choices survive a reload. Without this write the pane still LOOKS correct for the rest of the page-session -- every selection renders, Start carries it, the gate runs -- and forgets everything on the next load. That is invisible to any assertion made against a single HUD instance, which is why the persistence tests read back through a SECOND createHud over the same Storage. Re-measured at hud.navigation.test.ts once #318's layer cases joined the file: the callback-and-store sweep's negative control expects a role click to write exactly once. Pinned by name since the hud suite was split (issue #511); its killers live in hud.navigation.test.ts.
